title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
description: Chewy oatmeal cookies with plump raisins, brown sugar and a hint of cinnamon, with crisp edges and soft, thick centers.

image.alt: Oatmeal raisin cookies on a plate

steps.text: Cover the raisins with hot water for {time 10 min} to plump them, then drain and pat dry. Heat the oven to {temp 350F oven} and line the baking sheets.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter with both sugars until creamy, {time 2 min}. Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour mixture, then the oats and raisins, until evenly combined.
Scoop rounded 2-tablespoon balls onto the sheets with a {len 2 in} gap between them. Bake one sheet at a time until the edges are golden but the centers still look soft, {time 11-13 min}.
Cool on the sheet for {time 5 min} before moving to a rack; they firm up as they cool.

notes: Chill the dough for 30 minutes for thicker cookies that spread less.
Keeps 5 days in an airtight tin.
